about: What this feeder has recorded, how YA-WAMF works, and what it stores and sends.
dashboard: The last 24 hours at your feeder, and anything waiting on you.
events: Browse, filter, and manage every classified visit.
add_observation: Classify your own photo or video, review the evidence, and add it to your history.
audio_history: Calls BirdNET-Go has heard, by species and source.
notifications: Visits, alerts and background work, newest first.
species: Which birds visit most, how often, and when.
health: Whether YA-WAMF is working, what the host is doing, and what happened.

settings_tab.connection: Where events come from: Frigate, its MQTT broker and the cameras to watch.
settings_tab.detection: How sure an identification must be before a visit is named, and what is never saved.
settings_tab.models: Which models find and name birds, and the hardware they run on.
settings_tab.integrations: Other services YA-WAMF reads from or reports to, and your location.
settings_tab.ai: An optional AI provider that describes what a bird was doing.
settings_tab.notifications: When you hear about a visit, and the channels the message goes to.
settings_tab.security: Who can open YA-WAMF, what guests see, and what leaves this install.
settings_tab.data: What is kept, for how long, and a backup of these settings.
settings_tab.maintenance: Jobs that repair or fill in the history, and deleting it.
settings_tab.beta: Features still being tested. Each is off until you turn it on, and may change or be removed. Turning one off keeps what it has already recorded.
settings_tab.appearance: How YA-WAMF looks and names birds.
settings_tab.accessibility: Contrast, a reading font, motion and spoken updates.

model_evaluation: How often each installed model names a bird correctly, and how fast.
